subject.title: fix(subagents): preserve requester wake on visible delivery failure

question: Should required visible-delivery failure become terminal once the requester wake succeeds, or remain independently retryable?
rationale: This choice determines cleanup, retry budget, detached-task status, and restored-state semantics; tests can validate either implementation but cannot select the intended user-facing delivery policy.

options.title: Accept terminal split
options.body: Credit requester wake, persist visible delivery as failed, clear the pending payload, and stop retries.

options.title: Preserve independent retries
options.body: Credit requester wake while retaining visible delivery as pending until it succeeds or exhausts its retry budget.

recommendation.title: Accept terminal split
recommendation.body: Credit requester wake, persist visible delivery as failed, clear the pending payload, and stop retries.
